updatesFromCustomers.text: 나는 1주일 머무르동안 목욕가운을 단 1번도 사용한적이 없었다. 그런데 첵크아웃하는데 목욕가운 1개가 없다고 돈을요구했습니다. 그런가보다 하고 지불할려고하는데 2개전부다 없다고 2개값을 지불해라고 했습니다. 그래서 1개가 없다면 이해되는데 2개다 없다는것은 너희들이 원래부터 준비를 안한것이다 하니 소용이 없었습니다. 결국에는 1개값 504000동을 지불했습니다.

ownerUpdates.text:
( english below )
Tại Aria Boutique Hotel Hoi An, phòng họp được thiết kế chỉn chu với với không gian riêng tư, mang đến môi trường chuyên nghiệp cho các buổi họp, hội thảo hay đào tạo quy mô nhỏ.
Bên cạnh không gian làm việc, khách sạn còn mang đến trải nghiệm lưu trú thoải mái, ẩm thực đa dạng và dịch vụ tận tình, giúp khách tham dự vừa làm việc hiệu quả vừa tận hưởng khoảng thời gian thư giãn tại phố Hội.
-----------
At Aria Boutique Hotel Hoi An, our meeting room is carefully designed with a private and comfortable space, creating a professional setting for meetings, small seminars, and training sessions.
In addition to the meeting facilities, guests can enjoy a comfortable stay, a variety of dining options, and warm hospitality. It is the ideal place to combine productive work with a relaxing stay in the charming town of Hoi An.

𝐇𝐞𝐥𝐥𝐨 𝐉𝐮𝐥𝐲
Tháng Bảy đến như một lời thì thầm của mùa hạ. Ánh nắng khẽ nghiêng trên những mái ngói rêu phong, dòng sông lặng lẽ ôm lấy phố Hội, còn thời gian dường như cũng chậm lại để mỗi người có thể sống trọn vẹn hơn với từng khoảnh khắc.
Giữa miền bình yên ấy, Aria Boutique Hotel Hoi An hiện lên như một khoảng dừng đầy thi vị, nơi những xúc cảm được đánh thức bởi sự hiếu khách chân thành, vẻ đẹp thanh lịch và những trải nghiệm được chăm chút trong từng chi tiết. Để rồi, mỗi kỳ nghỉ khép lại đều hóa thành một câu chuyện đẹp, lặng lẽ lưu giữ trong ký ức và dịu dàng theo bước chân của mỗi vị khách. 
-----------
July arrives like a gentle whisper of summer. Golden sunlight falls softly across the moss-covered rooftops, while the tranquil river quietly embraces the ancient town of Hoi An. Time itself seems to slow down, inviting every traveler to fully embrace each precious moment.
Amid this peaceful setting, Aria Boutique Hotel Hoi An offers a graceful retreat where heartfelt hospitality, timeless elegance, and thoughtfully curated experiences awaken the senses. As each stay comes to an end, it becomes a beautiful story—one that lingers softly in memory and accompanies every guest long after the journey has ended.

Chúng tôi luôn trân trọng từng lời nhận xét, góp ý và sự tin tưởng của Quý khách. Đó là động lực để Aria Boutique Hotel Hoi An tiếp tục nâng cao chất lượng, chăm chút từng chi tiết và mang đến những kỳ nghỉ trọn vẹn hơn mỗi ngày.
✨ Hy vọng sẽ sớm được chào đón Quý khách quay trở lại và tiếp tục đồng hành trong những hành trình khám phá vẻ đẹp yên bình của Hội An.
----------
Every 5-star review from our guests is a great source of motivation for the team at Aria Boutique Hotel Hoi An to continuously enhance our service and create memorable experiences.
We truly appreciate every review, kind word, and valuable feedback from our guests. Your trust inspires us to pay attention to every detail and strive to make every stay even more enjoyable.
We look forward to welcoming you back to Aria Boutique Hotel Hoi An and being part of your future journeys to discover the timeless charm and peaceful beauty of Hoi An.

𝐑𝐨𝐨𝐟𝐭𝐨𝐩 𝐏𝐨𝐨𝐥 & 𝐁𝐚𝐫: 𝐀 𝐂𝐡𝐚𝐫𝐦𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐍𝐢𝐠𝐡𝐭 𝐕𝐢𝐞𝐰 𝐨𝐟 𝐇𝐨𝐢 𝐀𝐧
Tựa như một góc nhỏ lơ lửng giữa bầu trời phố Hội, hồ bơi rooftop tại 𝐀𝐫𝐢𝐚 𝐁𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐪𝐮𝐞 𝐇𝐨𝐭𝐞𝐥 𝐇𝐨𝐢 𝐀𝐧 mang đến trải nghiệm thư giãn đầy ấn tượng với tầm nhìn toàn cảnh Hội An về đêm. Hãy thả mình vào làn nước xanh dịu, nhấp một ngụm cocktail mát lành tại rooftop bar và để những ánh đèn lung linh của phố Hội làm nên một buổi tối thật chill, thật đáng nhớ.
------------
Like a peaceful little corner above Hoi An, the rooftop pool at 𝐀𝐫𝐢𝐚 𝐁𝐨𝐮𝐭𝐢𝐪𝐮𝐞 𝐇𝐨𝐭𝐞𝐥 𝐇𝐨𝐢 𝐀𝐧 offers a relaxing and memorable experience with a beautiful night view of the ancient town. Enjoy the cool blue water, take a sip of a refreshing cocktail at the rooftop bar, and let the sparkling lights of Hoi An create a truly chill and unforgettable evening.

𝐐𝐮𝐢𝐞𝐭 𝐃𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐜𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧, 𝐆𝐞𝐧𝐮𝐢𝐧𝐞 𝐂𝐚𝐫𝐞
Sự chuyên nghiệp đôi khi không nằm ở những điều dễ dàng nhận thấy, mà hiện diện trong những khoảnh khắc rất đỗi bình dị. Tại Aria Boutique Hotel Hoi An, đội ngũ an ninh là những người đầu tiên chào đón du khách bằng nụ cười thân thiện, lời chào ấm áp và sự hiện diện đầy tin cậy. Với sự nhanh nhẹn trong việc hỗ trợ hành lý cùng cách đón tiếp ân cần giúp mỗi vị khách cảm nhận được sự thoải mái và an tâm ngay từ những phút giây đầu tiên. 
-----------
Professionalism is not always shown through big or obvious actions. Sometimes, it can be found in simple and meaningful moments. At Aria Boutique Hotel Hoi An, our security team is often the first to welcome guests with a warm smile, a friendly greeting, and a reassuring presence. Their quick support with luggage and attentive service help guests feel comfortable and at ease from the very first moments of their stay.

Tình yêu của ba hiếm khi được nói bằng những lời hoa mỹ, mà được gửi gắm trong sự hy sinh thầm lặng, những lần chở che và sự đồng hành qua từng chặng đường con lớn lên.

Cảm ơn ba đã từng nhập vai một đứa trẻ để chơi cùng con, là người bạn khi con cần và là người ba tuyệt vời nhất mà con luôn tự hào. Với con, ba là người đàn ông tuyệt vời nhất trên thế giới. ❤️
----------
A father's love is rarely expressed through grand words. Instead, it is reflected in his quiet sacrifices, his protection, and his unwavering presence throughout every stage of his child's life.

On the occasion of Father's Day, Aria Boutique Hotel would like to extend our warmest wishes to all the amazing fathers out there.
Thank you, Dad, for becoming a child to play with me when I was young, for being a friend when I needed one, and for being the wonderful father I have always been proud of. To me, you are the greatest man in the world. ❤️

Với diện tích 43m², gồm hai phòng ngủ riêng biệt, hạng phòng 𝗦𝘂𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗙𝗮𝗺𝗶𝗹𝘆 mang đến sự rộng rãi, riêng tư và thoải mái, phù hợp cho gia đình 3–4 người trong những chuyến nghỉ dưỡng tại phố Hội.
Căn phòng được bao phủ bởi ánh sáng tự nhiên từ ban công và khung cửa sổ rộng mở, mở ra tầm nhìn dịu dàng hướng về Hội An yên bình. Từng chi tiết trong không gian được chăm chút để mang lại cảm giác gần gũi, thư thái và trọn vẹn như một chốn nghỉ dưỡng của riêng gia đình bạn.
Đặt phòng ngay hôm nay để cùng những người thân yêu tận hưởng một kỳ nghỉ ấm áp và đáng nhớ tại Aria Boutique Hotel Hoi An
----------
With an area of 43m² and two separate bedrooms, the 𝗦𝘂𝗶𝘁𝗲 𝗙𝗮𝗺𝗶𝗹𝘆 offers a spacious, private, and comfortable stay, perfect for families of 3–4 people during their holiday in Hoi An.
The room is filled with natural light from the balcony and large windows, with a peaceful view of Hoi An. Every detail is carefully prepared to bring a warm, relaxing, and comfortable feeling, just like your own family retreat.
Book your stay today and enjoy a warm and memorable holiday with your loved ones at Aria Boutique Hotel Hoi An.

( english below )
Mang trong mình vẻ đẹp trầm mặc và dịu dàng của phố Hội, Aria Boutique Hotel Hoi An không chỉ là nơi dừng chân trong mỗi chuyến đi, mà còn là nơi lưu giữ những khoảnh khắc ấm áp và thân quen.
Tại Aria, sự hiếu khách được gửi gắm qua từng nụ cười chân thành, từng không gian được chăm chút và từng giây phút bình yên bên những vị khách thân thương.
-----------
With the quiet and gentle beauty of Hoi An, Aria Boutique Hotel Hoi An is not only a place to stay during your trip, but also a place to keep warm and familiar moments.
At Aria, our hospitality is shown through every sincere smile, every carefully prepared space, and every peaceful moment shared with our dear guests.

( english below )
Aria Pub được thiết kế khéo léo lồng ghép những nét đặc trưng của Hội An qua chất liệu gỗ ấm áp, nền gạch, ánh đèn dịu nhẹ và không gian gần gũi với tầm nhìn hướng dòng Thu Bồn thơ mộng. 
Nơi đây, mang đến một cảm giác thư thái như một khoảng dừng chân nhẹ nhàng giữa nhịp sống chậm đặc trưng của Hội An. Không gian nhỏ xinh nhưng đủ để mỗi vị khách tìm thấy sự riêng tư, nhâm nhi một ly cocktail, trò chuyện cùng bạn bè hoặc đơn giản là ngắm nhìn phố Hội chuyển mình khi chiều dần buông xuống.
-----------
Aria Pub is thoughtfully designed to reflect the distinctive charm of Hoi An through its warm wooden elements, traditional tiled flooring, soft ambient lighting, and inviting atmosphere, complemented by views overlooking the poetic Thu Bon River.
Here, guests can enjoy a sense of tranquility, like a gentle pause amidst the slow-paced rhythm of Hoi An. Though intimate in size, the space offers just the right amount of privacy to sip a handcrafted cocktail, share conversations with friends, or simply watch the ancient town gradually transform as evening falls.

( english below )
Hồ bơi rooftop tại Aria Boutique Hotel Hội An mang đến một khoảng trời thư giãn thật nhẹ nhàng giữa lòng phố Hội. Từ làn nước xanh trong, những chiếc ghế nằm dưới nắng và tầm nhìn rộng mở hướng về dòng sông và phố Hội, mọi thứ như chậm lại để bạn tận hưởng trọn vẹn từng khoảnh khắc nghỉ dưỡng. 
Đây là nơi lý tưởng để thả mình trong làn gió mát, ngắm nhìn Hội An từ trên cao và lưu giữ những phút giây bình yên, trong trẻo bên người thân yêu.
----------
The rooftop pool at Aria Boutique Hotel Hoi An offers a gentle and relaxing escape in the heart of the ancient town. With its crystal-clear water, sunlit loungers, and open views over the river and Hoi An’s charming old town, everything seems to slow down, allowing you to fully enjoy every moment of your stay.
It is the perfect place to unwind in the cool breeze, admire Hoi An from above, and cherish peaceful, refreshing moments with your loved ones.

reviews.textTranslated: The room was clean, and the shower filter was good enough to use every 2-3 days. The breakfast was decent, and the swimming pool wasn't small with good water quality. It is located a bit out of the way, so walking to the Old Town makes you sweat profusely haha. It was great to rent a bike after breakfast and ride around the neighborhood for some exercise. The nearby Tiffany Nail Spa does a really good job with nails haha.

Pros: The hotel is new, and the rooms are clean, modern, and comfortable.

Cons: The breakfast buffet was a bit chaotic. The dining area is quite small, making it feel crowded, and food wasn't restocked promptly, so some dishes were unavailable for a while.

Service: The bellboys were polite and helpful. However, our checkout experience with the front desk was disappointing. We were accused of taking a teaspoon because they couldn't find it in our room. Although we ended up paying for it, we were asked to search for it ourselves, which caused unnecessary delay and frustration. It felt like the situation could have been handled much more professionally. I hope the hotel improves how it manages these kinds of incidents in the future, as it left an unpleasant impression despite an otherwise good stay.

Super sweet and helpful stuff! Me and my father stayed there and had trouble connecting our computer to the television, we went down to reception and were told the technician is not currently there. Later the receptionist went to our room and solved the problem with the technician on face time! Super nice place and breakfast also. We were disappointed they charged us for water the was labelled as "amenity" but overall very positive experience. (Pretty shit view though)

reviews.textTranslated:
Since it is a newly built hotel, the rooms and the building are very clean.

It is also great that the air conditioning is running in the hallways.

However, the male receptionist and the breakfast staff are very unfriendly.

They do not return greetings even when I greet them first, and they are curt.

Also, there is construction right next door, and it was incredibly noisy.

I checked in late at night and barely managed to fall asleep, but from 6 AM onwards, I couldn't sleep due to the drilling sounds, the intense vibrations, and the deafening noise that felt like my ears were going to fall off.

The drilling sounds stopped the next day, but

I still couldn't rest comfortably due to the hammering sounds and the chatter of the workers from early morning.

Furthermore, the housekeepers here are overly diligent.

They visit after 9 PM.

If you want to stay up late, you must put up a "Do not disturb" sign.

Also, there was an instance where they left without refilling the towels, toilet paper, or water after cleaning the room. The night market is too far to walk to, the breakfast menu isn't very diverse and the food isn't great, and the staff aren't particularly friendly, so I will not visit again.

The bellboy and the receptionist were friendly!
reviews.text:
새로 지어진 호텔이라 객실과 건물은 매우 깨끗하다.
복도에 에어컨이 가동하는것도 너무 좋다.
그런데 리셉션 남직원, 조식당 직원들이 매우 불친절하다.
먼져 인사해도 인사도 안받아주고, 퉁명스럽다.
그리고 바로옆에 공사중인데 진짜 너무너무 시끄러웠다.
체크인을 새벽 늦게 하고 겨우 잠들었는데,
새벽6시부터 드릴소리에 진동도 엄청 쎄고 귀가 떨어져 나갈듯한 소음에 잠을 이룰 수 없었다.
다음날부터는 드릴소리는 없었지만
이른 아침부터 망치소리, 인부들이 공사하며 하는 말소리들로 편히 쉬지는 못했다.
그리고 이곳의 하우스키퍼들은 너무 부지런하다.
9시가 넘으면 방문한다.
늦게까지 쉬려면 Do not disturb 를 꼭 걸어둬야한다.

This was a really nice place. I was pleasantly surprised. The staff was very friendly and helpful. The room was nice and large. A few things to note is that the temperature was hard to control so it was either freezing cold or stuffy and hot. The shower was also really nice with a large shower head. The balcony was shared with the room next door and the view on level two was not very good.

The pool is great! Best view in the entire city and during the hot summer months it was so nice to have to jump in after sweating all day long. There is a small cafe up top as well.

The gym is small and in the basement but good enough if you really need to get something in. There is also a sauna and steam room but you have to let them know ahead of time so they can turn them on.

The breakfast was very good. Lots of options and different food on different days. Great assortment of juices, fruits and pastries and then all kinds of traditional foods as well. Omelet bar and special of the day included.

Check in is at 3:00 and there is no getting around it unless you want to pay extra however, the price is negotiable. I arrived at 6:00 am but was fine with leaving my stuff at the bell hop and then wandering the city until check in.

Overall I thought this was a great value and would recommend to anyone visiting. If i returned I’d likely stay here again.

reviews.textTranslated:
There are many accommodation options in Hoi An. After looking around, I decided to stay a bit further out, where there would be much less noise from people and vehicles. It's about a 15-minute walk from the hotel to the Old Town. If it's not raining, it's not far to walk along the riverbank or the road. However, September is the rainy season, so it becomes a bit inconvenient when it rains, as there will be standing water along the way, and the sidewalks are not in good condition, full of potholes and often blocked by cars and motorcycles.

Welcome snacks were provided upon check-in. The hotel's floors 2-7 are the accommodation area, the first floor houses the lobby, swimming pool, bar, and dining area, and the basement contains a gym and spa. I chose a river-view room, specifically requesting a high floor, and the hotel provided a second-to-top floor. The view at night was truly beautiful; the lights of the riverside houses and the moonlight reflected on the riverbank, with occasional small boats carrying lanterns passing by. Although there were occasional horn sounds, the soundproofing was decent, and I wasn't disturbed much while sleeping at night. The bathroom had a separate shower and toilet, and the bathtub was quite large. A common problem with Vietnamese hotels seems to be unstable water pressure and hot/cold water; mold was also clearly visible. The equipment looked high-quality in photos, but in actual use, it felt like cheap, knock-off items.


The first floor is the breakfast dining area. When we went downstairs the next day, it was probably still too early; the Vietnamese didn't feel hot, so they didn't turn on the air conditioning. They only turned it on around 8 am when it got a little warm. On the third day, it rained, and the weather was cooler, so they didn't turn on the air conditioning either. The dining environment was clean, and the selection was quite good, much better than the supposedly four-star sea-view hotel we stayed at in Da Nang later. This time, we chose the hotel's spa. Firstly, we didn't have to travel long distances, and secondly, it was more comfortable to shower before the massage. The price was reasonable. Although they asked if we wanted a strong, regular, or gentle massage, it felt like they were just asking. The gentle massage felt a bit painful, while my wife's strong massage felt too soft. There were welcome snacks before the massage, but the staff stood in front of us, making it impossible to relax. The bamboo tube spa really involved rolling heated bamboo tubes over our bodies—it was so hot it hurt! It's more suitable for people who like a strong massage and have thicker skin.


This accommodation included one free airport transfer from Da Nang to the hotel. You'll see staff holding nameplates as you exit the airport. If you book through the hotel, the transfer to Da Nang costs 300,000 VND. Previous reviews mentioned that calling a Grab car is cheaper, and the hotel's rental cars weren't in great condition. Considering the rainy season and the potential difficulty in finding a ride, I booked through the hotel beforehand. The car used was a manual Vios, and it was indeed quite old, but the driver was okay.

In terms of price, there are probably more affordable accommodations in Hoi An, but a river-view room for less than 2,000 VND per night for six days is acceptable. It's about a 15-minute walk to the Old Town and about a 10-minute walk to the Hoi An Show. However, if you have elderly people or children, staying in the Old Town would be more convenient.
reviews.text:
會安住宿選擇蠻多的，看了一輪決定住在外圍一點的地方，人車聲音的干擾會少很多，從飯店走到古城區大概15分鐘左右，沒下雨的話沿著河岸走過去或走馬路不算遠，不過9月開始是雨季，下雨就會有點不方便，因為沿途會有積水，人行道也不算完善，坑坑洞洞之外也會有汽機車占據。

入住有迎賓小點心，飯店2-7樓是住宿區，1樓是大廳泳池跟酒吧用餐區，地下室是健身房跟SPA區，這次選了河景房，有特別註明要高樓層，飯店也給了次頂樓，晚上看出去真的蠻漂亮的，河邊房舍燈光與月光映照在河岸上，偶爾有提燈小船經過，雖然時不時有喇叭聲，但隔音還算可以，晚上睡眠的時候不太會被干擾，衛浴是乾濕分離，浴缸蠻大的，越南飯店的通病好像都是水壓跟冷熱水不穩，發霉的部分也清楚可見，設備看起來跟拍起來有質感，不過用起來就像掏寶貨啷啷的。

一樓是早餐用餐區，第二天下樓的時候，可能還太早，越南人覺得不熱所以沒開冷氣，快八點吃到有點熱的時候才開，第三天下雨，天氣比較涼爽，所以也沒有開冷氣，用餐環境乾淨，選擇也算多，比後來去峴港住的號稱四星海景飯店好多了；這次選了飯店的SPA，一是不用舟車勞頓，二是可以先沖個澡再按摩比較舒服，價格算合理，雖然會問要重手普通還是柔軟，但整體感覺起來就是問而已，要柔軟感覺偏痛，太太要重手感覺偏軟，開始之前也有迎賓小點心，不過服務人員會站在前面，沒辦法有放鬆感，竹筒SPA就真的是拿加熱竹筒在身上滾，熱到刺，比較適合喜歡重手加皮厚一點的人。

這次住宿有含一次免費峴港機場接送到飯店，出機場就會看到接送人員拿著姓名紙板，如果透過飯店訂，接送到峴港的費用是30萬盾，看到之前評論說自己叫GRAB會比較便宜，而且飯店叫的車況也不太好，考量到雨季可能不好叫車，所以還是先透過飯店訂了車，當天接送的車是手排VIOS，確實車況偏舊，不過司機態度還OK。

以房價來說，會安應該還有更多更便宜的住宿，但六日一晚不到兩千的河景房，走路到古城區大約15分鐘，到會安秀大約10分鐘，距離算可以接受，只是如果有長輩或小孩的話，住在古城區還是會方便一些。

reviews.textTranslated:
The rooms are clean and the view is better than anywhere else in the area, but the hallway is like a greenhouse and very hot. They don't turn on the air conditioning in the hallway, only in the rooms. Lizards might come up onto the balcony in the evening, but they don't enter the rooms. Also, there are flying cockroaches, typical of Vietnam, in the hallway; they do enter the rooms, but the probability is low because the room air conditioning keeps the temperature low.

The breakfast is on the smaller side in terms of variety and size, but the taste is above average. The pho changes daily with options like beef and chicken. The bread is French-style, which has a different texture than German bread, but I am satisfied. On days when stir-fried chicken is served, you can make a top-notch chicken banh mi by dipping a baguette in it.

The shower water in the bathroom is clean.

From midnight to 10 AM, a chicken from the next-door neighbor crows; by around 10 AM, it crows so loudly that its voice becomes hoarse, and then it stops, perhaps because its voice is hoarse.

The remote control stopped working because the battery died; it would have been nice if they had provided spare batteries.

I highly recommend this hotel. Location is great, very near the old town and there’s shops and restaurants nearby. Staff was also great. We had a problem with our room because of paint smell and they happily moved us to another room which was bigger than what we booked (free upgrade!). Breakfast selection was also so good.

They also offer van service to/from airport or Da Nang - price was super worth it especially if you’re a big group.

I have no complaints about this hotel. Truly a wonderful stay!

Cozy An Boutique Hotel is a lovely, quaint property in a great location, about a 10 minute walk from Hoi An’s Old Town.

The location was perfect for us as it’s not too busy and we could stroll into the old town along the river or via the road. Near the hotel there are plenty of restaurants, spas, minimarts, coffee shops and a laundromat all within easy walking distance. There’s also a newly opened sports bar with the largest tv screen in Hoi An a few doors down serving AMAZING hot pies.

The hotel is beautifully decorated and has a good sized swimming pool, free bicycles and a buffet breakfast with a good variety of options. There is also a small gym, although we didn’t use it as there are only a few pieces of equipment. The rooms are a decent size, clean and have a nice view. As we’re travelling with kids, we opted for a family interconnecting room, which was well priced and adequate for what we needed.

reviews.textTranslated:
I booked a room with a river view on the 7th floor and stayed for two nights.

The price was about 150,000 won for two nights.

I was also able to use the free pickup service from Da Nang, so I saved about 10,000 won on taxi fare.

Above all, the staff were incredibly friendly.

I was especially grateful for the local staff member who liked Korea and could speak a little Korean and treated me with such kindness.

The breakfast was fresh and delicious, and since it was served from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM, I liked being able to enjoy a leisurely breakfast compared to other hotels.

The swimming pool next door was also well-maintained, and I made good use of the free bicycle rental service.

If you know how to ride a motorbike, I recommend renting one for about 1.5 million VND per day.

It is really convenient for getting around the area.

Overall, I was very satisfied with the value for money, and the staff were incredibly friendly.

If I come back to Hoi An, this is a place I definitely want to stay at again.

다낭에서 무료 픽업 서비스도 이용할 수 있어서 택시비 약 1만 원도 아꼈습니다.

조식도 신선하고 맛있었고,
이용 시간이 오전 6:30~10:00까지라 다른 호텔보다 여유롭게 아침을 먹을 수 있어서 좋았습니다.

주변을 돌아다니기 정말 편해요.

전체적으로 가격 대비 만족도가 높았고 직원분들도 너무 친절했습니다.

다음에 호이안에 다시 오게 된다면 무조건 다시 이용하고 싶은 숙소입니다.

We spent our final day at Fusion Resort Da Nang.

The breakfast menu also featured an excellent variety and taste, perfect for Korean palates.
reviews.text:
퓨전리조트 다낭에서의 마지막 일정을 보냈습니다.

This was an absolutely wonderful hotel. The room was spacious, cleaned beautifully every day, and very comfortable. We couldn't do any sea activities due to bad weather, but we thoroughly enjoyed yoga, the pool, and spa massages. Phiphi-san's yoga was especially fun, and I went every day! I highly recommend it. Making bracelets was also fun. You can make cute bracelets with colorful strings.
Also, I had emailed them in advance to let them know that I wanted to celebrate my parents' 30th wedding anniversary, and they prepared a lovely cake plate in our room. Thank you very much!
If I had to nitpick, it was a little disappointing that the body wash and hand soap were the same. It would also be great if basic skincare products such as lotion were provided.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Xin chào,

Thank you very much for sharing such a heartfelt review of your stay at Fusion Resort & Villas Da Nang.

We are delighted to know that you enjoyed the comfort of your room, our daily housekeeping, and the variety of wellness activities available despite the unfavorable weather. It is especially wonderful to hear that Phiphi-san’s yoga sessions became a highlight of your stay and that you enjoyed making colorful bracelets. We will gladly share your kind recognition with Phiphi, as your appreciation will mean a great deal to her.

We are also pleased that the anniversary cake arrangement added a special touch to your parents’ 30th wedding anniversary celebration. It was our pleasure to help make this meaningful occasion even more memorable.

Thank you as well for sharing your suggestions regarding the body wash, hand soap, and skincare amenities. Your feedback is valuable as we continually look for ways to enhance our guests’ comfort and experience.

We hope to have the pleasure of welcoming you and your family back for another relaxing and memorable stay, hopefully with better weather to enjoy our beautiful beach as well.

Warm regards,
Fusion Resort & Villas Da Nang

title: Emerald Hoi An Riverside Resort
description: Casual quarters with balconies or terraces in a laid-back, riverside resort offering dining & a spa.
address: 127 Ngô Quyền, Phường, Hội An, Đà Nẵng 560000, Vietnam
plusCode: V8FF+QC Hoi An, Da Nang, Vietnam
hotelDescription:
This laid-back resort on the shores of the Thu Bon River is an 11-minute walk from the 15th-century Hoi An Ancient Town and 29 km from Danang International Airport.
 Featuring furnished balconies with pool, garden and/or river views, the relaxed rooms have Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, minibars, and tea and coffeemaking facilities. Refined suites add terraces and offer in-room dining.
 Breakfast is available. Additional amenities include a restaurant that has patio seating, as well as an outdoor pool, and pool and riverside bars. There's also a spa, a fitness center and a library. Tours can be arranged.

450 GUESTS - ONE JOURNEY TO DISCOVER A NEW FLAVOUR | BANH MI ANH CHÍN FESTIVAL 2026

The Banh Mi Anh Chín Festival 2026 brought new creations to the table, inviting 450 guests to taste, explore, and help answer one question: What could become the signature flavour of a new brand?

Staying true to the soul of Vietnamese Banh Mi while exploring fresh combinations inspired by local flavours, “Vietnamese Banh Mi with a Local Fusion Twist” marked the beginning of Anh Chín’s journey - a brand shaped by flavour, stories, and, most importantly, the voices of those who tasted it.

A signature flavor in the heart of the Old Quarter

Leave behind the rush of everyday life and enjoy crispy, freshly baked Banh Mi at Emerald Hoian, set against a stunning green backdrop right by the pool.

Visit our charming little Banh Mi stall, built from rustic bamboo and thatch to evoke the authentic feel of a Vietnamese village. Here, you will taste an irresistible twist on tradition: savory charcoal-grilled skewered meat paired with rich, authentic Vietnamese sausage. It’s the ultimate midday treat to recharge your energy after a refreshing swim!

CULINARY DISCOVERY 

Discover the flavors of Central Vietnam through a cooking class at Emerald Hoi An Riverside. Guided by our local chefs, you’ll learn how to prepare each dish and turn familiar ingredients into authentic local flavors.

A fun and memorable way to experience Hoi An’s cuisine and take a taste of your journey home with you.

MEET. CONNECT. INSPIRE 

A professional, tranquil, and inspiring space for meetings, seminars, or important gatherings.
At Emerald Hoi An Riverside Resort, our meeting room is designed to ensure every gathering is not only productive but truly enriching, set amidst lush greenery and the peaceful rhythm of life along the Hoi An River.

Meet – Connect – Create memorable moments together.

𝑹𝒆𝒔𝒕. 𝑹𝒆𝒄𝒉𝒂𝒓𝒈𝒆. 𝑹𝒆𝒏𝒆𝒘. 

After wandering through the ancient streets, strolling along the Hoai River, or exploring the beauty of Hoi An, your body deserves a moment of stillness to rest and recover.

Let Emerald Spa be your ideal destination, where all your senses are relaxed in a tranquil space and intensive treatments help relieve stress, release fatigue after a long day, and regenerate positive energy and balance for both body and mind.

BBQ BUFFET DINNER – GREAT FLAVORS, LIVE MUSIC & RELAXING MOMENTS

Gather your family and friends for an unforgettable evening at BBQ Buffet Dinner at Oasis Restaurant – Emerald Hoi An Riverside Resort.
Indulge in a generous buffet featuring fresh seafood, premium grilled meats, hot dishes, fresh salads, and delicious desserts, all carefully prepared by our talented culinary team in a warm and relaxing atmosphere.

🎶 Adding to the experience, enjoy live music performed by our Filipino band, creating the perfect ambiance for a memorable night.

✨ Available every Wednesday, starting from 22 July 2026.
Time: 6:00 PM – 9:00 PM
Food Package: VND 399,000 NET per guest
Beverage Package: VND 239,000 NET per guest
• Includes 2 hours of free-flow beverages: Beer, Soft drinks, Fruit juices 

Venue: Oasis Restaurant – Emerald Hoi An Riverside Resort

Let the delicious flavors, live entertainment, and warm hospitality of Emerald Hoi An Riverside Resort make your evening truly special.

reviews.textTranslated:
Koreans, please take a look. Complaints.

I was satisfied with the accommodation itself considering the price, and it was nice swimming while looking at the river.

However, you thoughtless Korean parents, please, straighten up your behavior.

It is not education to let your kids throw dozens of stones into the pool just because your child is the best. Not only does it dirty the water, but there are 10 to 22 stones piled up on the bottom; don't you think about the other guests?

If you want to play in a public pool while abroad, please get some common sense. If you don't like that, go to a private pool villa instead.

The staff check the water quality every 1 to 2 hours, but perhaps because of the reviews, they didn't say a single word while the lower elementary kids were throwing stones. They don't even pretend to listen when my father says a word.

If I gave a low rating, it wouldn't climb to the top, and I felt sorry for the hotel, so I gave it a perfect score. Considering how many Koreans visit Da Nang, it is obvious that if I say one wrong thing, they will spread hell on affiliate communities like Mom Cafe and Da Nang Dokkaebi, and then downplay my criticism to just one or two stars to prove they were right. So naturally, I am afraid to speak up. Nevertheless, I will send an email directly to the hotel asking them to stop this kind of behavior.

Please, get some common sense. Is having a child your greatest achievement? I feel sorry for the children growing up under such parents, and I am afraid of encountering them in society in the future.

I am ashamed to be of the same nationality as them.
reviews.text:
한국인들 꼭 보세요. 불만.

숙소 자체는 가격대비 만족했습니다 강바라보면서 수영하기도 좋았구요

그런데 무개념한 한국 ☆부모☆들 제발 행동 좀 똑바로 하세요

애들이 수영장에 돌 수십개씩 던져넣으면 우리애가 최고라서 냅두는게 교육이 아닙니다 수질이 더러워지는 것은 물론이고 바닥에 돌이 10~22개 쌓여있는데 이용객들 생각은 안하시나요?

해외나와서 공용 수영장에서 놀고 싶으면 개념은 탑재하세요 제발. 그게 싫으면 풀빌라 가시던지요

직원들 1~2시간에 한번씩 수질 체크하는데 리뷰때문인지 초등 저학년 애들 돌던지는데 한마디도 안하더라구요? 저희 아버지가 한마디해도 들은척도 안합니다

별점 낮게 달면 상위로 올라가지도 않을 뿐더러 호텔측 입장도 불쌍해서 만점 달아뒀습니다 다낭 한국인들이 얼마나 많이 오는데 말한마디 잘 못 했다가 맘카페부터 다낭도깨비 등등 제휴카페에 똥 싸지르면서 자기들이 잘했다고 돌 1~2개로 축소해서 글적을거 뻔하니까 말하기도 당연히 무섭죠 그래도 호텔측으로 직접 메일 넣어둘겁니다 이런일 제지해달라고요

제발 개념 탑재 좀 하세요 애있는게 최대업적들이세요? 그런 부모 밑에서 자라는 애들이 불쌍하고 향후 사회에서 만날까봐 두렵습니다

같은 한국인이라는게 쪽팔립니다

reviews.textTranslated:
We had a wonderful stay at this hotel and would return in a heartbeat!

The location is fantastic – just a short walk to the Old Town. Our room was very spacious, cozy, and charmingly decorated, making us feel right at home.

We especially want to commend the outstanding staff. Everyone was incredibly friendly, attentive, and helpful. After a few days, they even started addressing us by our first names – which made our stay even more special.

The hot pot was a truly memorable experience. Mr. Quang prepared it for us, and it was one of the best culinary experiences of our entire trip to Vietnam. It was absolutely delicious! Ms. Uyen also took wonderful care of us and was incredibly accommodating at all times.

Many thanks to the entire team for the lovely time and the warm hospitality. We would definitely return and wholeheartedly recommend this hotel!
reviews.text:
Wir hatten einen wunderschönen Aufenthalt in diesem Hotel und würden jederzeit wiederkommen!

Die Lage ist super – man braucht nur wenige Minuten zu Fuß bis zur Altstadt. Unser Zimmer war sehr groß, gemütlich und wirklich süß eingerichtet, sodass wir uns direkt wohlgefühlt haben.

Besonders hervorheben möchten wir das ausgezeichnete Personal. Alle waren unglaublich freundlich, aufmerksam und hilfsbereit. Nach einigen Tagen wurden wir sogar schon persönlich mit unseren Vornamen angesprochen – das hat den Aufenthalt für uns noch besonderer gemacht.

Ein ganz besonderes Erlebnis war der Hot Pot. Herr Quang hat ihn für uns zubereitet und es war eine der besten kulinarischen Erfahrungen unserer gesamten Vietnam-Reise. Es hat wirklich hervorragend geschmeckt! Auch Frau Uyen hat sich sehr herzlich um uns gekümmert und war jederzeit unglaublich zuvorkommend.

Vielen Dank an das gesamte Team für die schöne Zeit und die herzliche Gastfreundschaft. Wir würden definitiv wiederkommen und können das Hotel von Herzen weiterempfehlen!

title: Naman Retreat
description: Refined seaside property offering lavish rooms & villas, some with private pools, plus posh dining.
address: Trường Sa, Road, Ngũ Hành Sơn, Đà Nẵng 550000, Vietnam
plusCode: X79M+VM Ngu Hanh Son, Da Nang, Vietnam
hotelDescription:
Set in striking buildings built from bamboo, this luxe beachfront resort is 5 km from the Marble Mountains and 14 km from the Vinahouse Museum.
 Sleek rooms offer balconies, flat-screens and free Wi-Fi. Chic 1- to 3-bedroom villas add private pools, hot tubs and kitchens, plus living rooms, dining areas and terraces, some of which are set on rooftops with sea views. Room service is provided.
 Dining options include a woodsy-chic Vietnamese restaurant, a lavish cafe, and a hip poolside bar with live music. The resort offers beachside yoga, cooking classes and an outdoor pool, plus a premium spa with hot tubs, steam rooms, a sauna and a gym.

reviews.text: Absolutely loved staying at Namia, it was just bliss from the moment we arrived.  Don’t let the words ’wellness’ or ‘retreat’ put you off, this is a fabulous hotel with wellness options available if you want them.  You can still get beer, wine and cocktails and a really good choice of food and it’s delicious. The villas are exquisite - there’s a huge amount of space, free mini bar, towels regularly replaced, a beautiful private pool, I could go on and on about the amenities available.  There are free bikes to get round the resort and go into town, although we walked in a few times too.  There are loads of free gym and yoga sessions, free shuttle boats into town, different classes on option and then the free spa sessions, they were out of this world.  But the main thing that sets this hotel apart from others is the staff.  Every single one cannot do enough to help, they are fantastic.  Quynh, our host, was so quick to respond to any questions we had and offered up suggestions as to how she could help even further any time we contacted her.  We both loved staying here and even 3 days of rain (it is the rainy season after all) didn’t remotely spoil our stay..

If I could give more than 5‑star rating to Namia Retreat, I would happily give it 10 stars. This resort has been the most beautiful, comfortable and welcoming place my family and I have stayed, not just around Da Nang, but across all of Asia.

The resort only has a small number of rooms, yet every single service is delivered with so much care and attention. A special shout‑out to our butler Quynh. She answered all our questions in great detail, checked in on us regularly and helped us with absolutely everything she could.

There is an amazing range of on‑site activities. We loved the morning yoga, tai‑chi, coconut‑boat rides, and the boat transfer over to Hoi An Ancient Town. Every activity was such a wonderful surprise for our group.
The spa experience also deserves a special mention. Gorgeous surroundings combined with professional treatments helped us unwind deeply during our vacation.

We have since moved over to Tia Hotel by My Khe Beach. Even though it is also a resort property, it simply cannot compare with Namia Retreat.
We will definitely be coming back to Namia on our next trip to Hoi An. I highly recommend this wonderful retreat to everyone!

reviews.text:
My first Vietnam trip = NAMIA. 🇻🇳✨

I originally chose Vietnam for this trip because I wanted to stay at InterContinental Danang. It was exactly my kind of hotel. But for just one night, I worried that the location might mean seeing very little beyond the resort.

Then I found Namia River Retreat — and choosing Namia completely changed the trip.

Our private villa came with its own pool, the food was fantastic, the farm-to-table concept was such a lovely touch, and the whole property had this incredibly peaceful atmosphere. 🌿

The breakfast was especially memorable. The bánh xèo was so crispy and delicious that we ordered it several times. In fact, everything we tried was so good that every meal became something to look forward to.

There were also so many activities and experiences to enjoy that we wished we had more time. We wanted to try everything, but our stay was simply too short. If we visit again, we would love to stay longer and fully enjoy everything Namia has to offer.

And one of the biggest perks? A 90-minute spa treatment is included in the stay. 🙌

Yes — 90 minutes. Included.

And this is not your typical hotel spa. I could write a whole separate review about it, but I’ll simply say:

Just go. Experience it for yourself. You’ll understand. 🤍

Then there was Tuyen.

We were celebrating a birthday, so this was already a special trip for us. From before we even arrived, Tuyen helped arrange our spa and sunset cruise, sent thoughtful reminders before our reservations, and our buggy was waiting for us before we even had to ask. 😂

Tuyen also arranged a river-view upgrade for us, and the view was absolutely beautiful. 🌅 For a one-night stay, that thoughtful gesture meant even more. It made our short stay feel incredibly special.

At one point, I actually thought:

“Wait… do we have a personal butler now?” 😂

That’s how attentive the service felt.

And then came the 4 PM late check-out.

For a one-night stay?!

FOUR. PM. 😭😂

I didn’t even know that was possible.

The Vietnamese afternoon heat had me a little nervous about spending the day outside, but the extra time meant we could slow down and enjoy our private pool, the river view, the spa, and simply do absolutely nothing.

And that is exactly what a retreat should feel like. 🤍

Beyond the beautiful villa, the food, and the facilities, it was the thoughtful hospitality that stayed with us.

Tuyen made our first Vietnam experience one we’ll always remember — not just as a beautiful stay, but as a very special birthday trip filled with moments we’ll treasure. ❤️

So now, when I think of Vietnam…

Vietnam = Namia.

If you’re looking for another typical five-star hotel, there are plenty of them.

But if you want a true retreat — private, peaceful, beautifully designed, with incredible food, a 90-minute spa included, plenty of activities, and service that feels genuinely personal — choose Namia.

Don’t overthink it.

Just go. You’ll understand. 🌿✨

And if Tuyen is your host, you’re in very good hands. 🤍

reviews.text:
As a luxury travel advisor who spends a lot of time visiting and evaluating hotels around the world, Namia River Retreat really stood out to me during my time in Hoi An.

First, the food was out of this world. Every meal felt thoughtful, fresh, and beautifully prepared. I also loved the design of the accommodations. Having a private plunge pool with every room is such a great touch, and the complimentary bikes make it incredibly easy to explore the surrounding area. pro tip (vietnam breakfast via room service in the morning).

What really sets Namia apart for me is the wellness component. The included daily spa treatment is something I rarely see, and it became one of my favorite parts of the stay. The riverside sauna and cold plunge were equally fantastic and added to that feeling of truly being on a retreat.

The staff could not have been warmer or friendlier. Service felt genuine and personal throughout my stay.

I also think they have absolutely nailed the location. You are close enough to Hoi An to easily enjoy the restaurants, shops, and energy of town, but removed enough that when you return to Namia, it feels like your own peaceful little oasis along the river.

For clients looking for Hoi An with a strong sense of place, exceptional food, wellness, and a little more tranquility, this is a property I will happily recommend. I would absolutely return myself.

title: RiverTown Hoi An Resort & Spa
description: Upmarket hotel offering river views & dining, plus a gym, an outdoor pool & free breakfast.
address: 47 Thoại Ngọc Hầu, Hội An, Đà Nẵng 560000, Vietnam
plusCode: V8G9+9R Hoi An, Da Nang, Vietnam
hotelDescription:
On An Hoi island, surrounded by the Thu Bồn River, this upmarket hotel with views of the Ancient Town is 6 km from An Bang beach and 29 km from Da Nang International Airport.
 Featuring river and/or town views, the warmly decorated rooms have free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and safes, as well as minifridges, and tea and coffeemaking facilities; many add private balconies. Suites come with living areas; some are bi-level. Family quarters are available. Room service is offered.
 Complimentary perks consist of a beach shuttle, loaner bikes, and a breakfast buffet served in an airy restaurant. There's also a bar, a gym and an outdoor pool.

Tung and all the staff were incredible!

An unforgettable stay with exceptional hospitality! 🌴✨

We have just spent three incredible days at Rivertown Resort & Spa in Hoi An, and honestly, it has been one of the best hotel experiences of our lives!

From the moment we walked in, Mr. Tung made us feel incredibly welcome. He was absolutely amazing, taking the time to sit us down, explain everything and ensure we were comfortable. Within just 10 minutes of checking in, he had arranged an upgrade to a beautiful Riverfront King Room on a higher floor. As if that wasn’t already incredible, we were also treated to complimentary evening high tea, which was hands down one of the most luxurious, elegant and memorable experiences we have ever had. The attention to detail and generosity exceeded all our expectations.

We also booked our coconut basket boat experience through the hotel, and everything was organised seamlessly. Our driver picked us up directly from the hotel, and on the way back, when we asked if we could visit the pottery village, he happily dropped us off at no extra cost. These thoughtful gestures really show how much the team cares about its guests.

The resort itself is absolutely beautiful, with a tropical atmosphere, stunning river views and a lovely swimming pool that makes the whole place feel like a little paradise. With the river flowing alongside the property and beautiful views on both sides, it is such a peaceful and relaxing place to stay.

The buffet breakfast was another highlight. The selection was fantastic, and we enjoyed some of the best traditional Vietnamese food we have ever tasted. One particularly lovely touch was watching a lady handcrafting fresh Vietnamese rice paper rolls right there in the buffet area. Everything was delicious, and the quality of the food was exceptional.

Every staff member we encountered was warm, friendly and welcoming, but Mr. Tung deserves a very special mention. His kindness, professionalism, genuine hospitality and willingness to go above and beyond made our stay truly unforgettable. He made us feel valued and cared for, and he is an absolute credit to the resort.

We cannot thank the entire team enough for making our three days in Hoi An so special. It is rare to find a hotel where the facilities, food, atmosphere and hospitality are all this exceptional.

If you are visiting Hoi An, we wholeheartedly recommend Rivertown Resort & Spa! We would return in a heartbeat and would love to see Mr. Tung and the wonderful team again.

Thank you for making this such a beautiful and unforgettable experience. We will always remember our stay here! ❤️

Stayed here for 2 nights and was honestly disappointing..

While the rooms were beautifully designed, it felt like the hotel prioritised form over function and everything felt very compact without any room to breathe.

The hotel also suffered a power outage at 5am and the staff did not offer any explanation until we asked what was happening. During breakfast, they served the wrong meal and one of the reception was also always taking a nap..

The location was also a little far but I guess would work if the preference is for a quieter residential area…

Much room for improvement!

I stayed fo 4 nights with my girlfriend. Great room and hotel. A lot of goods cover the spare so-sos.

Good:
+ Big room. Antique design but very new.
+ Deep (arguably too deep) bathtub.
+ Balcony.
+ Ok location. A lot of Grab drivers waiting to pick you up nearby. Open park with simple exercise equipment.
+ Nice pool for phototaking.
+ Breakfast is tasty.
+ Very friendly staff.

Meh:
± A bit far away from Da Nang city centre but closer to Hoi An and Marble Hills.

Bad:
- The pickup service to/from Hoi An involved a driver who keeps asking us if we wanna tailor some clothings. Politely rejected but still kept asking to a level that it's annoying.
- Would love a weight scale in the room but that's my niche need.
The hotel staff has been extremely polite and kind with us and our baby girl. Food is delicious and overall our stay was perfect!

We spent a total of 7 days at Olwen, and it was truly a pleasant stay! It’s tucked away in a quiet neighborhood, overlooking a lovely park and playground where you can really feel the local community vibe.

The interior has a fantastic mid-century aesthetic, which is the main reason I chose it in the first place. The room was cozy and well-decorated, though personally, I think it would be great if they added an exhaust fan in the bathroom so it wouldn’t get quite so stuffy while enjoying the bathtub. That said, the neighborhood is very peaceful at night, so you're guaranteed to get a good night's sleep here! 😌

While the location isn't right in the city center, getting around via Grab is a breeze, and it’s only an 8 to 10-minute walk to the beach.

One of the highlights was definitely the breakfast, which also comes with a complimentary drink, homemade yogurt, and free-flow tropical fruit.

The staff are wonderful, incredibly friendly, and always fulfilled our requests promptly. A huge thank you to Nikola, Lily, Khaa, and the whole team for making our stay so special! 🥰🫶🏼

ご飯が美味しい。

立地いい。

Greetings from Malaysia. We were greeted by friendly staff when checking in, process was precise and did not waste too much time. Booked the studio room for a week and it was spacious and neat with ample space for 2 pax to move around and open our luggage. There's a bathtub in the toilet which is elevated and couples can enjoy a nice bath to unwind especially when it's hot outside. There's also a pool on the top floor if you fancy a swim, very intimate space and not for a big crowd but most of the time you should be able to have the space to yourself. Breakfast every morning was outstanding with complimentary drinks (if you opted for breakfast). Location wise it is fairly close to the beach (depending on how prime of the beach area you wanna be at) and very easy to get a Grab ride to everywhere in Da Nang. 24/7 convenience store is also situated several blocks away, very walkable. Overall stay was very pleasant, highly recommended if you want to escape the busyness of Da Nang main area (you'll be guaranteed to have quality sleep). Thank you Nikola, Lily, and the wonderful staff team (that I didn't manage to get their names) for the hospitality and meeting our requests promptly.

title: Hoi An Beach Resort
description: Laid-back property offering warm quarters, plus breakfast, 2 restaurants & a spa.
ownerDescription: Hoi An Beach Resort is 4 star beach resort has long been proud of its idyllic setting and gracious hospitality. The resort is uniquely situated in Hoi An, the Vietnamese World Heritage site famous for its long-standing architectural complex, located in the middle of the Cua Dai Beach and De Vong River as is an oasis of peace where the river meets the ocean. Luxuriously appointed Vietnamese style houses and villa rooms, plus tropical garden & private beach crate the perfect environment for a getaway.
address: 01 Cửa Đại, Hội An Đông, Đà Nẵng, Vietnam
plusCode: V9X8+29 Hoi An Dong, Da Nang, Vietnam
hotelDescription:
Opposite Cửa Đại Beach, this laid-back resort overlooking the Đế Võng River is 5 km from the Museum of Trade Ceramics.
 The relaxed, warm rooms feature minibars, flat-screen TVs and safes, plus tea and coffeemaking facilities. Upgraded rooms add balconies or terraces; some include pool views or garden access. Suites offer living areas, river views and whirlpool tubs. Wi-Fi is available.
 Breakfast is available. Other amenities include 2 restaurants and 3 bars, plus gardens, 2 outdoor pools and a private area on the beach. There's also a lobby lounge, a gym and a spa, as well as a billiard table, loaner bikes and cooking classes.

Dear Our Valued Guest,
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us.
We are truly sorry to learn that your stay did not meet your expectations and that you left feeling disappointed with several aspects of your experience.
Please accept our sincere apologies the beach construction,
Most importantly, we have taken your feedback regarding the alleged discrimination at our restaurant very seriously.
We consider this matter in high regard, as every guest deserves to be treated with fairness, respect, and kindness, regardless of their nationality. The experience you described is entirely inconsistent with the hospitality standards we strive to have
We expect to clarify that our hotel does not engage in any form of racial discrimination; all guests are treated with equal respect. Regarding to this situation, a table was already occupied by guests who arrived earlier before you therefore, it was not possible to reassign that table to you.
It appears there may have been a misunderstanding between you and our staffs at the restaurant
We sincerely apologize for any distress this incident may have caused you.
Again, thank you for bringing these concerns to our attention.
We value your feedback and hope you will allow us the opportunity to serve you in the future
Kind regards,
The Resort Management Team

I had a wonderful experience at Hoi An Beach Resort, located at 01 Cua Dai Street, Hoi An. The resort boasts a lush, peaceful, and airy environment, perfect for relaxing and enjoying a vacation with family and friends.

The rooms were clean, spacious, and comfortable. The staff were friendly, enthusiastic, and always ready to assist guests with a professional and attentive attitude. I especially loved the close connection with nature and the tranquil atmosphere the resort provided.

reviews.text:
Tôi đã có một trải nghiệm rất tuyệt vời tại Hoi An Beach Resort, địa chỉ số 01 Cửa Đại, Hội An. Khu nghỉ dưỡng có không gian xanh mát, yên bình và thoáng đãng, rất thích hợp để nghỉ ngơi, thư giãn và tận hưởng kỳ nghỉ bên gia đình, bạn bè.

Phòng nghỉ sạch sẽ, rộng rãi và thoải mái. Đội ngũ nhân viên thân thiện, nhiệt tình, luôn sẵn sàng hỗ trợ khách hàng với thái độ chuyên nghiệp và chu đáo. Tôi đặc biệt yêu thích không gian gần gũi với thiên nhiên cùng bầu không khí thư thái mà khu nghỉ dưỡng mang lại.

Vị trí của resort cũng thuận tiện cho việc khám phá Hội An và các địa điểm tham quan xung quanh. Nhìn chung, đây là một lựa chọn tuyệt vời cho những ai đang tìm kiếm một nơi nghỉ dưỡng thoải mái, chất lượng dịch vụ tốt và không gian yên bình.

Tôi rất hài lòng với trải nghiệm tại Hoi An Beach Resort và chắc chắn sẽ quay lại trong những dịp tiếp theo. Tôi cũng sẽ giới thiệu nơi này đến bạn bè và người thân khi có dịp đến Hội An!

Rất đáng trải nghiệm khi đến Hội An!

reviews.text:
If you’re looking for a peaceful place away from the crowds and the city, I would definitely recommend this hotel. The staff are generally nice, especially Miss Hien, who was very kind and helpful.

The facilities are a bit outdated, and some rooms need renovation. The food was okay, but there could be more variety. The pho was the only dish that changed daily, while most of the other food stayed the same.

One thing we noticed was the service in the restaurant and bar. When I asked a girl at the bar for a bucket of ice, she seemed annoyed. The second time I needed ice, I decided to go to the bar myself because I didn’t want her to feel like I was ordering her around. We also felt that some restaurant and kitchen staff were warmer toward Western guests than Asian guests, which made us feel a little unwelcome.

Overall, most of the staff were friendly, and we enjoyed the peaceful location. With some renovation, more food variety, and more consistent hospitality, the experience could be much better.

We had the best time at Hoi An Beach Resort! The whole team at the hotel made us feel so welcome and special from beginning to end, we stayed there for five days in total.

We were kindly upgraded to a beautiful river view room because of our honeymoon, and were treated to a romantic meal for free. The river view room is superb, the room itself was spacious and kept super clean.

The hotel is the perfect size; small but still felt secluded with all the trees and plants. Our room was located just next to one of the swimming pools and the other infinity pool a short walk away too. We loved watching the De Vong River from both our room and the River Breeze Restaurant. The breakfast buffet was very good, with a fantastic selection of high quality food on offer.

Thank you SO much!

hotelDescription:
Overlooking Non Nuoc Beach, this upmarket hotel is 8 km from the Museum of Cham Sculpture and 10 km from Dragon Bridge.
 The high-end rooms feature earth-toned interiors, and offer free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, minibars, and tea and coffeemaking facilities, as well as balconies. Upgraded quarters have sea views and executive lounge access. Suites add living rooms, and apartments add kitchens. Modern villas with private pools and 24-hour room service are also available.
 Amenities include outdoor pools, tennis courts, a gym, a spa and a kids' club. There are 3 formal and casual restaurants, a bakery and a bar/lounge.

We had an amazing 6 nights at this property in a Regency Suite Club Room which was absolutely huge. The bath was amazing, the walk in wardrobe also and massive balcony.

We came to have a break of quiet relaxation and although being a huge resort with what appeared many families, we spent the days by the Regency Pool which meant we were generally the only people there. There is also an adults only pool which was a bit further away.

The Regency Club was fantastic for breakfast and evening drinks and canapés. Only suggestion would be to enforce a dress code to prevent people wandering around in thongs and very casual attire. Would also suggest making one end of the lounge more explicitly a ‘quiet zone’ or for adults only.

Xanh House had amazing food. Loved the Banh Mi!

Overall, we loved it here but the best part about this property are the staff. Every single person we encountered was just amazing. Special call outs to Doris in the lounge, Tuan Pham in Concierge and everyone else. I wish I could remember everyone’s names because you were fantastic!

Our one complaint and reason for not giving 5 stars is the ‘Little Farm’. No hotel should have a petting zoo. There were a couple of animals including a goat and a rabbit which looked very unwell. The rabbit could not walk and was lying in its own filth in the scorching sun. I would strongly suggest that this closes and is used just as a garden.

This property is definitely worth staying at. Even if just for the staff & service alone.

I was trying to contact their Reservation Team for 3 times in one morning. First time, was cut off due to an emergency call, requested them to call back in 5 minutes. I was waiting but no one got back, made the 2 nd call, was put on hold and requested to wait again for another 30 minutes and still no calls. Had to call back again for the THIRD TIME and was put on hold for another 15 minutes for their " SUPERVISORS".

NEVER EVER COME BACK OR EVEN LET MY KIDS AROUND HYATT.

STAY AWAY especially families with kids. YOU WOULD HAVE TO WAIT for Sake knows HOW LONG.

Beautiful grounds, but no place for a quiet stay

I stayed solo October 2026, on a points redemption. Hyatt markets this resort as sitting on "a tranquil stretch" of Non Nuoc beach. On the first day of my stay, a large private event in a tent within sight and earshot of my room ran a full concert production from 5 pm to 10 pm: hundreds of badge-wearing attendees, moving lights, concert-level sound, and multiple live singers and musicians. A letter handed to me at check-in mentioned an event and its setup, but no one explained it, nothing in it suggested a concert, and no quieter room was offered in advance. I was offered a move only after the music started, when I was already sick in bed.

I was ill for much of the stay and had to arrange my own doctor through personal contacts. No one at the resort offered medical help. Other lapses: I was sent down the entrance ramp in heavy rain to collect a Grab delivery of medicine, the check-in sheet listed the wrong room service hours, my final breakfast order was wrong, and there was a dead bird outside my room (photo attached), a faulty fan switch, confusing light switches, and broken lights.

Update: Management apologized in writing and in person, covered some room charges. They declined to refund any of the points I redeemed and offered 15,000 bonus points instead. Housekeeping was excellent, and the front office manager was gracious, but I won't return. Families with young kids may enjoy the pools and kids' club. Solo travelers and couples looking for quiet should look elsewhere, or at least ask at check-in whether any events are scheduled.

I had only one issue with this hotel and it's the red flag on their beach, which we had during our whole stay. For 3 days I literally could not get into the water! Their safety guys were whistling on me constantly as I went in the water. If you want to swim in the water, this is not a good hotel as they are overly restrictive. If you walk just down to the next hotel, they will have yellow flags, while this resort has red flags.... Anyway, we had our conversation with the management, hope they will do something with this. Otherwise it's a decent place, very clean and just beautiful. My favourite part was the wellness, so amazing as its empty most of the time. Amazing.

We stayed in a 3-bedroom apartment in Residence Block A and had a wonderful stay overall. The apartment was very clean, spacious and comfortable, with an amazing view of the sea.

The resort is especially great for families with young children. There’s plenty to keep the kids entertained — kids club, swimming pools, a sand play area next to kids pool, direct access to the beach, and even a mini zoo, which was surprisingly well maintained. Breakfast was also enjoyable with a good selection.

The only downside for me was the location of the gym. It was quite far from our residence block, and the route there was very dark at night, which made it a little difficult to navigate.

Overall, a very comfortable and family-friendly stay. We really enjoyed our time here and would happily return, especially for another family trip.

title: Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort and Spa
description: Polished beachfront resort offering free loaner bikes, plus 3 bars, a spa & a restaurant.
address: Beach, Âu Cơ, Street, Hội An Đông, Đà Nẵng 840511, Vietnam
plusCode: V9W9+7W Hoi An Dong, Da Nang, Vietnam
hotelDescription:
Set between the Thu Bon River and the sea, this upscale beachfront resort is 5 km from the Museum of Trade Ceramics and 6 km from the 16th-century Japanese Covered Bridge.
 Sophisticated rooms with furnished balconies offer free Wi-Fi; upgraded rooms add river or garden views. Polished suites feature separate living areas, flat-screen TVs and whirlpool tubs. Some have outdoor showers. Room service is available,
 There are free loaner bikes, plus 2 tennis courts, 3 bars and a restaurant, Other amenities include an infinity pool, a gym, and a spa with a sauna and a hot tub.

reviews.text: Me and my wife stayed at this Resort from the 28/8/2026 until 4/9/2026 this was my first time in this resort but my wife has stayed there 3 times but everything was just great the staff were very friendly and the service was exceptional the staff remembered my wife from her previous visit and one staff member Cu'c really went out of her way in making us very welcome and looking after us on our stay. It was a shame that we never got to see her the day we left as it was her day off but the hole resort was just great breakfast was fabulous and we had a deal where you could have a lunch meal in the day or dinner at night and after dinner a cocktail every night we stayed. Great massage and a lovely pool to relax in and if we go back to Vietnam which we will as we are looking forward to heading back again next year and it will be back to Victoria Beach and spar Resort as this is like a home away from home. Thank you Victoria Beach and spar Resort for looking after us on our stay and looking forward to heading home again next year. 10 out of 10 for your hospitality. Regards Mark Eschbach and Angie Kennedy Australia
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear Angus,
Dear Valued Guest,

Thank you so much for taking the time to share such a wonderful review following your recent stay at Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort & Spa.

We are delighted to hear that you and your wife had such a memorable experience with us. It is especially heartwarming to know that, after your wife’s previous visits, you both felt so welcomed and that our team made you feel at home during your stay.

We are very pleased that you enjoyed our breakfast, dining benefits, cocktails, massage and relaxing pool, and we truly appreciate your kind words about our service and hospitality.

We would also like to thank you for your special mention of Cu’c. We will certainly share your lovely compliments with her and the rest of our team. We are sorry that you did not get the chance to say goodbye before departing, but we are sure she will be delighted to know how much you appreciated her care and attention.

Knowing that Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort & Spa feels like a “home away from home” is the greatest compliment we could receive. We are thrilled to hear that you are already looking forward to returning to Vietnam next year, and we sincerely hope to welcome you and your wife back for another relaxing and memorable stay.

Thank you once again for your generous 10 out of 10 rating and for choosing to stay with us.

Warmest regards,
The Management Team
Victoria Hoi An Beach Resort & Spa

reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Dear valued guests,
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re sorry to hear that your experience did not meet your expectations.

We would like to clarify that the complimentary voucher provided was specifically for a foot bath, not a foot massage. As our Front Desk team also explained during your visit, the foot bath consists of soaking the feet in warm water and does not include a massage treatment.

We understand that there may have been a misunderstanding regarding the voucher, and we regret if the experience was different from what you expected. We will continue to review how we communicate our complimentary services to ensure that the details are clear to our guests.

Regarding your comments about breakfast and our service, we appreciate you sharing your concerns, as guest feedback helps us identify areas where we can improve.

We sincerely regret that your stay did not leave you with a positive impression, and we wish you all the best.
With regards,
The Management team

reviews.textTranslated: Update 2026: My family returned and was still very satisfied. This year, the beach extends along the entire length of the resort, not just at the two ends like last year. The resort is beautiful, with a large swimming pool and a children's wading pool. After 6-7 pm, there are no lifeguards on duty, but adults can still swim 24/7. The rooms are spacious and well-equipped. The balconies and bathrooms are large, with a big bathtub. The atmosphere is very pleasant. The breakfast buffet is delicious and varied. The staff are friendly and enthusiastic, providing information about the resort and surrounding areas. The resort provides a shuttle bus to the old town and bicycles for guests to borrow. You can ask the staff for assistance in renting a motorbike. The environment is child-friendly. My family stayed for two nights and was very happy.

Our stay at David’s Airbnb was absolutely incredible—far beyond anything we expected! From the moment we arrived, David and his amazing staff made us feel so welcome and taken care of. Their hospitality was truly next level. I had found a pretty big shark tooth and left it on the table, not realizing it might get mistaken for trash. When we asked if they happened to have seen it, they literally went through the trash to find it for us! That level of care and dedication blew us away.

They have a whole menu of food and drinks that you can order from and they will come make it for you in your kitchen and then clean everything up. Everything we ordered from them was absolutely delicious. If you’d prefer to cook yourself, they will go to the market and stuff for you and deliver groceries to the villa.

David went above and beyond in every way—arranging taxis, giving us fantastic recommendations, and even making reservations for us. He made everything so easy and stress-free.

The location is perfect—on a mostly quiet little street with four great restaurants just steps away. Wild Beach Restaurant right next door is a huge bonus, with amazing food and top-tier customer service. And the property itself is a dream! The fence surrounding it makes it feel like your own private little oasis, offering a perfect blend of peace and seclusion while still being close to everything.

We truly can’t recommend this place enough. If you’re considering staying here, do it! You won’t regret it. Thank you, David and team, for making our trip so special!

reviews.textTranslated:
A short review of Santori Pool Villa Hoi An
Last October, I was looking for a villa for my team. After days of searching and receiving many offers from sales representatives, I chose this one simply because of its youthful, modern style and vibrant colors that suited my team.
Luckily, before checking in, I contacted the owner beforehand, and she was very lovely. Before arriving, I received a lot of advice: for example, "Hey, we have speakers," "We have a stove, just remember to buy charcoal for grilling," or "Hey, we have all the plates and dishes for the group, would you like to check in early?"...
It felt so nice and friendly.
When the time came, our team checked in, and everyone was excited and happy. The room design was very simple, not too elaborate, but very clean. The pool was crystal clear and great; we could swim from morning till night without getting sunburned.
There's also a space on the rooftop for relaxing in the evening.
The location is quite easy to find, convenient for both Da Nang and Hoi An.
Cups, pots, condiments, etc., are sufficient for a team of 20-30 people. Even better, there's an ice shop right opposite, so you can get more whenever you need it.
Overall, it's absolutely fantastic ❤️

reviews.textTranslated:
Hoiana Resort & Golf – Luxury with a Touch

Hoiana Resort & Golf is a large resort complex on the coast of Vietnam near Hoi An. Its spacious grounds, beautiful beaches, swimming pools, restaurants, and golf club create all the conditions for a premium vacation. 🏖️

However, there are some downsides: the distance from the center of Hoi An, the need to spend time traveling outside the complex, and the relatively high prices. The large grounds may lack a cozy feel, and choosing activities outside the resort will require additional planning.

✨ Overall, Hoiana is suitable for those looking for a comfortable seaside vacation, but the atmosphere of a secluded luxury resort comes at a price – not only in terms of money but also in terms of distance from city life.

Hoiana Resort & Golf — роскошь с нюансами

Hoiana Resort & Golf — масштабный курортный комплекс на побережье Вьетнама недалеко от Хойана. Просторная территория, красивые пляжи, бассейны, рестораны и гольф-клуб создают все условия для отдыха премиум-класса. 🏖️

Однако есть и минусы: удалённость от центра Хойана, необходимость тратить время на поездки за пределы комплекса и довольно высокий уровень цен. На большой территории может не хватать ощущения уюта, а выбор развлечений за пределами курорта потребует дополнительного планирования.

✨ В целом Hoiana подойдёт тем, кто ищет комфортный отдых у моря, но за атмосферу уединённого люксового курорта придётся заплатить — причём не только деньгами, но и некоторой удалённостью от городской жизни.

reviews.textTranslated: Hoi An Resort is a luxurious and excellent resort that has it all, featuring a variety of rooms and facilities, a golf course, and a casino. It truly deserves a 5-star rating. I think I have visited about 5 or 6 times. The Residences, New World Hotel, and the higher-class Beach Resort and Suite Resort are all great options for families (I have stayed in every room type); there is almost no difference in quality between them. The Beach and Suite Resorts, which are attached to the casino, are simply a bit more upscale and offer better accessibility. You can get around by buggy or walk for 5 minutes. Hoi An Shores Golf Course is a links course that is well-maintained. I have visited every golf course in Da Nang, and the management here is top-notch (personally, I like dunes and links courses). With Vinpearl Golf Course just 5 minutes away, it is ideal for a golf trip. It is also close to Hoi An Old Town, so there are plenty of things to eat, see, and enjoy, such as massages, dining, and performances. You can even take a basket boat ride at the mouth of the Thu Bon River. Thanks to the shuttle service, the convenience and accessibility for traveling between Hoi An, Da Nang, and the airport are excellent. The staff are all friendly and kind, and the service is truly top-notch. It is a service that accommodates everything. The breakfast is delicious, and there is a wide variety of food. All the facilities are spacious and luxurious. There is a food court called "Garden" that features Vietnamese, Chinese, and Korean cuisine, including the restaurant *Obaltan*. There are two swimming pools, a cafe with an infinity pool, and a dry sauna next to it (free of charge). And the highlight of this resort is, of course, the casino. It is the best resort because it allows for a hotel staycation, golf, casino, and sightseeing all at once.
reviews.text: 호이아나 리조트는 다양한 객실과 시설, 골프장, 카지노까지 모든 것이 다 갖춰진 럭셔리하고 훌륭한 리조트입니다. 진정한 별5개입니다. 약 5~6회 정도 방문한 것 같고요. 가족들이 머물기 좋은 레지던스, 뉴월드 호텔, 상급 객실로 비치리조트와 스위트 리조트 모두 좋습니다 (모든 객실 투숙) 퀄리티 차이가 거의 없이 다 좋습니다. 카지노와  같이 붙어 있는 비치, 스위트가 좀 더 고급스럽고 이동 편의성이 있을 뿐. 버기로 다녀도 되고 걸어도 5분입니다.  호이아나 쇼어스골프장은  링크스 코스이고 관리가 잘 되어 있습니다. 다낭 내 모든 골프장 다 가봤는데 관리는 최상급입니다.(개인적으로 듄스, 링크스 코스 좋아합니다), 옆에 5분거리에 빈펄골프장도 있어서 골프여행으로 최적입니다. 호이안 올드타운도 가까워 마사지, 식사, 공연, 먹고 볼게 많아요. 투본강 하구에서 바구니배도 탈수 있습니다. 셔틀이 있어서 호이안, 다낭, 공항 이동편의성, 접근성이 매우 좋아요. 직원들은 모두 친절하고 상냥하며 서비스는 가히 최상입니다. 모든 걸 다 받아주는 서비스입니다. 조식 맛있고 음식의 종류 다양합니다. 모든 시설이 여유롭고 럭셔리 합니다. 가든이라는 푸드 코트도 있는데 베트남음식, 중식, 한식 오발탄도 있어요. 수영장은 2곳, 인피니티 풀이 있는 까페,  그 옆에 건식 사우도도 있어요.(무료),  그리고 이 리조트의 하이라이트는 역시 카지노죠.  호캉스, 골프, 카지노, 관광, 모두가 가능한 리조트라 최고입니다.

☕ TOP 3 QUÁN CAFE VIEW BIỂN TAM THANH ĐỂ CHILL MÙA HÈ 🌊

Nếu bạn đang tìm quán cafe view biển Tam Thanh để ngồi chill, ngắm biển và tận hưởng nhịp sống yên bình của làng chài thì đây là 3 địa điểm rất đáng thử khi đến Tam Thanh Beach. 💙

1️⃣ George’s Beach Bar
Quán cafe & bar sát biển do người Anh mở, mang vibe tropical mộc mạc và cực kỳ thư giãn. Anh chủ từng sống ở Bali trước khi chọn ở lại biển Tam Thanh vì yêu cuộc sống chậm và bình yên nơi đây.

• View thẳng biển Tam Thanh
• Chill ngắm hoàng hôn, nghe sóng biển
• Đồ ăn Tây đơn giản, không khí “healing” 🌴

2️⃣ Rio Coffee
Quán cafe view biển được nhiều bạn địa phương yêu thích nhờ không gian mở và gần gũi.

• Đón gió biển cực mát
• Hợp cafe sáng hoặc đọc sách chiều
• Dễ kết hợp check-in làng bích họa Tam Thanh

3️⃣ Cam Cafe
Một quán nhỏ thú vị của cặp vợ chồng nước ngoài — chồng Canada, vợ Nam Phi.

• Không gian yên tĩnh, view biển thoáng
• Có lớp dạy tiếng Anh cho trẻ em địa phương
• Anh chủ chơi guitar tạo nên những buổi tối rất chill 🎸

📍 Lưu lại nếu bạn chuẩn bị du lịch Tam Thanh mùa hè này nhé!

reviews.textTranslated: The homestay owner was very helpful; even though the homestay doesn't have an elevator, she immediately helped me carry my large suitcase up to the 4th floor. She also recommended some pretty good and affordable places to eat. The homestay is located in a village, so it's very peaceful and close to the beach. There are two ways to get to the homestay: an internal village road and a road right by the beach (both accessible by motorbike). Getting from the homestay to the city is also quite convenient, and you can even head down to Tam Tien beach to visit the fishing village, which is also beautiful. I hope the homestay will welcome more guests in the future. Thank you so much to the owners!

hotelDescription:
This sprawling beachfront resort on the East Vietnam Sea coast lies 42 km from Da Nang International Airport and 13 km from the city of Hội An, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
 Polished rooms feature free Wi-Fi and minibars, as well as flat-screen TVs and balconies offering views of the pool and/or gardens. Upgraded rooms have sea views. Suites and 2- and 3-bedroom villas add separate living areas.
 Breakfast and an airport shuttle are complimentary. Other amenities include 3 restaurants and 2 bars, plus an 18-hole golf course, a wildlife park and beach access. There's also an amusement park, an outdoor pool & a gym, plus a spa and a kids' club.

reviews.text: lovely hotel right next to the beach, with a great pool and lovely helpful staff. Room was very clean, and the staff allowed us to leave our bags with them before and after check in as we arrived super early in the morning. overall a fantastic stay, would recommend!

I would like to start this review by highlighting that this is clearly an ownership/maintenance issue and NOT the fault of the lovely staff who were willing to attempt to sort out these issues that are out of their control.

Unfortunately, myself and my partner had a negative experience staying at HA Ocean Front, and I honestly don’t understand how there aren’t more reviews of people experiencing the same issues.

Firstly, when we initially arrived, we noticed that the front foyer and lobby was quite cluttered and untidy. Not an immediate issue, and it was at night time so we thought that perhaps our judgement was clouded. However, as we were walking up to our room we noticed a lot of stains on the carpets and walls, holes in carpet, and in front of the elevator, a couple of dead cockroaches. This is when we were becoming more uncomfortable of the cleanliness of the hotel.

After we were shown our room by their lovely night shift staff, we immediately noticed that the room was not up to standard as per shown on the photos. The floors were dusty and dirty, the roof was mouldy looking, the aircon wasn’t working properly, but worst of all, was the bathroom. The bathroom was just downright disgusting. The tiles in the bathroom and shower were cracked, mouldy, and clearly had not been cleaned properly due to a lack of maintenance. There was no toilet roll holder for the toilet paper, and there was a hole in the wall that had been badly patched up that we assume was from the old toilet roll holder. Our sink was clean to the naked eye, however there was a crusty lump of god knows what stuck to the side of the sink that resembled a booger or something of the sort.

The next morning, we spoke to the reception lady who did her best to ensure our comfortability was prioritised (offered us a new room, an upgrade at no cost) but ultimately, my partner and I decided it was best to checkout immediately as we did not feel comfortable staying at the hotel under the current conditions.

Again, this is no direct fault of the staff who simply work there and try their best to ensure their guests have an enjoyable stay, but this fell really flat for us. On booking.com they are listed as a 4 star hotel with a score of 8.4, but I truly do not understand how, when the hotel is presented in such a state, and there seems to be a lack of people experiencing the same issues. Hopefully, the business can reflect on this review and these issues, as they do have the potential, but it is clearly an ownership and maintenance issue.

Wir haben ein Hotelaufenthalt gebucht und haben uns sehr gefreut.
Als wir jedoch angekommen sind, waren wir sehr enttäuscht. Es ist ganz anders wie auf den Bildern. Die Zimmer sind ok, aber der Balkon sah sehr unsicher und kaputt aus und die Badezimmer waren auch ganz ok.

Jedoch war das Personal sehr nett und wir konnten einfach stornieren.

First of all, we would like to thank the staff. Everyone was kind, polite and professional throughout our stay. When we explained everything and showed our photos and videos, the hotel acknowledged the problems and offered us compensation, which we genuinely appreciated.

Unfortunately, the hotel itself has serious maintenance issues.

On our first night, the bathroom door became completely stuck and could not be opened. The room also had a terrible smell and the air conditioner was making unusual noises, so we had to change rooms.

In the second room, we found that the toilet was cracked, the air conditioner remote had no batteries, and the air conditioner started leaking. The next morning, my partner got locked inside the bathroom and I had to open the door from the outside. We reported the leaking air conditioner to the reception and were told it would be taken care of.

However, the following night the air conditioner leaked again and soaked our belongings. We have photos and videos of everything.

The staff handled the situation professionally, but the hotel’s maintenance clearly needs significant improvement. We hope these issues are resolved, because the employees deserve better facilities to work with.
